notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the clone-gated recreation (render.json says why it is not dist-gated), and the revised one draws the print fits listed in 720-002_DiffGearAxle.scad's header: the press clearance on the rod bore, and the boss grown to Ø10.4 with a chamfered tip that bears on the MR128's inner race alone. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
